# WM Cyber Events Core

> WordPress plugin for events, sessions and registrations: double opt-in through Brevo, session booking with a capacity check, check-in, invoice XML (EN 16931), DATEV and CSV exports, iCalendar files.

## Overview

`wm-cyber-events-core` is a WordPress plugin developed with an agentic workflow (AI coding agents). It stores events and sessions as post types mirrored into its own tables, takes registrations through a REST route, confirms them through a Brevo double opt-in mail, lets confirmed participants book sessions, checks them in and exports data. Documentation measured against the code: README.md, DEVELOPERS.md, docs/ARCHITECTURE.md, docs/GUTENBERG-BLOCKS.md. Code audit: docs/AUDIT-2026-09-15.md.

## Facts

- Requires WordPress 6.9+ and PHP 8.3+; CI tests PHP 8.3 and 8.4.
- REST namespace `cybevents/v1`; WP-CLI `wp cybevents`; shortcodes `cybevents_registration`, `cybevents_session_selector`, `cybevents_seat_map`, `cybevents_agenda`, `cybevents_calendar`, `cybevents_calendar_views`, `wm_events_views`.
- Scripts, styles and icons are served from the plugin; the server calls Brevo only with an API key.
- Exposes WordPress 6.5+ Block Bindings (`wm-cybevents/metrics`), GenerateBlocks 2.x Dynamic Tag (`wm_cybevents_metric`), and developer hooks (`wm_cybevents_ready`, `wm_cybevents_metric_value`, `wm_cybevents_public_rest_rate_limit`, `wm_cybevents_ics_output`). No PDF invoices, no payment, no captcha widget.
- No conformity with GDPR, BFSG or tax law is claimed.
- Version 1.2.3.
